post.threads_text:
Your Instagram profile might be sending customers away quietly.

A cafe in Anna Nagar can have great reels and still lose people at the profile. Usually it's one of these:

→ No clear way to contact you in the bio
→ "DM for price" with no reply for a day
→ Posts that never say what to do next
→ Old highlights with last year's menu

Fix these before you spend on ads.

Which one is your page doing right now?
